newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes slightly lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed slightly lower but volume rose, bourse sources said.
The 30-share index closed at 592.83 from 593.37 on Tuesday.
Volume was 3.458 million dinars against 400,814 dinars. Over-the-counter trade represented the most important part, with turnover of 3.123 million dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat gained 1.12 dinars to 38.77 dinars. Airline Tunis Air was up 0.6 dinar to 19.94 dinars. BNA bank rose 0.95 dinar to 31.94 dinars.
